versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Improved cover generation logic: now requires a confirmed topic, hook, or script for idea-based covers; style words alone are no longer accepted as input.
- When no photo or key frame is provided, the topic or hook is enforced as a required input and will not be inferred or invented.
- The default canvas for a Douyin feed cover is now set to vertical 9:16 unless otherwise specified; no longer reuses Xiaohongshu 3:4 defaults.
- Added specific guidance for headline and title placement: uses top or bottom third if user provides title, otherwise defaults to a text-safe area.
- Documentation updated for increased clarity and specificity regarding input requirements and cover creation workflow.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
Publish the reviewed Douyin Video Cover Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
